title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1981-05-09
lineage: Dolby B Decoded Cassette Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Korg MR-1000 > DSF 1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo > Korg AudioGate > WAV 24/96; Lineage: Wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0.1 > > iZotope RX4 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > WAv 16/44.1 > CD Wave > TLH > Flac16; Transferred by David Minches; Edited and mastered SIRMick
source: Sennheiser MD421 Dynamic Cardioid Microphones > TC D5 Cassette Recorders> Jim Wise's Cassette Audience Master; Location: Soundboard Stand permittted by Dan Healy;

ai_review.summary: Excellent high‑fidelity audience recording of a delightfully loose LI show featuring a standout Estimated Prophet solo
ai_review.review: Harry Morgan raves about this field (audience) tape, calling it a high‑quality capture that rewards playback on a good hi‑fi system. He notes the band was clearly feeding off the crowd, with a particularly memorable Jerry/Bob interaction during the Estimated Prophet solo, making for an enjoyable if not “greatest ever” performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review but it is overwhelmingly positive about both the musical performance and the audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Field recording praised for fidelity; taper described as experienced, resulting in clear, well‑balanced sound that captures crowd response nicely.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Band appears tuned‑in and feeding love back to the audience; performance described as a fun ride with moments of edge‑of‑collapse energy that resolve into a satisfying whole.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo in Estimated Prophet is highlighted, with speculation about his interplay with Bob during that moment.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for the interaction with Jerry during the Estimated Prophet solo.
